description: This file defines Smarty plugin functions for rendering a module selection panel and associated JavaScript logic in a SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: smarty_function_modules_selector
methods.description: Generates HTML for a module selection panel with checkboxes, based on available modules fetched via SearchModules::getModulesList().

methods.name: script
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript code that manages the behavior of the module selection checkboxes, updating a hidden input with their JSON-encoded states.
